title: Restriction isomorphism and ordinary derived descent
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and the finite-field datum $D$, with algebraically closed field $k$ and $\ell\ne D.p$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. For every field automorphism $\alpha$ and $g=\operatorname{Spec}(\alpha)$, there are isomorphisms $\sigma:\Gamma(s,-)\simeq\Gamma(s,g^{-1}-)$ on integral modules and $\rho:\operatorname{Fib}_s\simeq\operatorname{Fib}_s g^{-1}$ on the ambient derived category. The section function of $\sigma$ is exactly pointRestrictionRaw, and $\rho$ has the localization component equation written in [def-trf-source-section-stalk-cone-data], with the canonical exact-sections factorization. No constructibility or boundedness restriction is imposed.

proof.text: Specialize point_automorphism_sections_inverse to completed coefficients, obtaining the section isomorphism. Use its forward-map identity and the restriction-natural theorem to pin its values.

Derive this section isomorphism using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso, then the canonical mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, in the exact derived-category dictionaries used by the point fibre. Their factorization equations give the displayed localization equation after cancelling the identity mapHomologicalComplexCompIso. The section equality gives the required heterogeneous equality.

theorem trfSourceSectionRestrictionModel (hl : l ≠ D.p) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k) :
    ∃ (σ : pointIntegralSections l E D.k ≅
      inverseImageIntegralModules l E (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom)) ⋙
        pointIntegralSections l E D.k)
      (ρ : pointFibreIntegralAmbient D l E ≅
        inverseImageIntegralDerived l E (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom)) ⋙
          pointFibreIntegralAmbient D l E),
    (∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k)))
        (x : M.val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))),
        HEq (σ.hom.app M x) (pointRestrictionRaw l E
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom)) none M x)) ∧
    (∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ,
        ρ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
            (pointFibreIntegralAmbient D l E).map
              (X := (inverseImageIntegralDerived l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom))).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
              (Y := DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                (((inverseImageIntegralModules l E
                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
              ((inverseImageIntegralModules l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom))).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
            (trfIntegralSectionsFactors l E D).hom.app
              (((inverseImageIntegralModules l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
          (trfIntegralSectionsFactors l E D).hom.app P ≫
            (trfIntegralModuleQ l E).map
              (X := ((pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
              (Y := ((inverseImageIntegralModules l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom)) ⋙
                  pointIntegralSections l E D.k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
              ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex σ.hom (.up ℤ)).app P))
